text: どんな　トレーナーが　わたしを　まちうけて　いるのかしら　わくわく　するわ

structure.jp: どんな　トレーナーが
わたしを　まちうけて　いるのかしら
structure.en: are waiting for me, I wonder

patterns.name: 〜かしら
patterns.explanation: かしら at the end means 'I wonder', in a womanly way of speaking. まちうけて　いるのかしら = 'I wonder who is waiting'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb shows something going on right now. まちうけて　いる = 'are waiting'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end softens a statement and sounds womanly. わくわく　するわ = 'I'm so excited'.
